a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 operate rounds before anyone holds 4 cells, so we would both very likely die waiting. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. After that I commit to choosing operate every remaining round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. If you'd rather take the 4 yourself, say so and propose a fair way to settle it.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our original plan. From now on I will operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
